title: Follow-ups: review, cleanup, amend
summary: When a job stops (or a review plan with notify always passes), the LLM is sent the report and answers with the next proposal, not advice: a review plan if something DIED or the cause is unclear, a cleanup of what a review showed, the amended original plan once clean, or return .nil. The proposal goes through the same draft, source review and check; its leading comment is the diagnosis. Jobs submitted by a follow-up remember their origin; reports start with the History; jobs~find(name) reaches any earlier job. autopilot N runs up to N checked follow-ups. Live: DIED -> review-make-killed -> clean-stale-build-lock -> build-and-test-hello-retry (amended: new step 2 removes the stale lock) PASSED -> return .nil; 10 calls, $0.0032.
authority: built and tested (architecture Tom Dyer; coding and writing Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-11-24)
invariants: Died -> review the wreckage -> clean up -> amend the plan with a fix -> run it (Tom Dyer, 2026-11-24)
A repeat review that looks at the same things is discouraged
autopilot never runs a rejected proposal
